title: Bug: image paste fails in WSL2 when clipboard exposes image/bmp and XDG_SESSION_TYPE is unset

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a detailed and actionable bug report regarding image paste failure under WSL2 Ubuntu. It includes complete system environment context, steps to reproduce, root cause analysis (XDG_SESSION_TYPE being unset and clipboard exposing image/bmp), and verification details.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Addressing this issue requires modifying Linux display server detection fallbacks (handling WAYLAND_DISPLAY and DISPLAY when XDG_SESSION_TYPE is unset) and supporting image/bmp MIME type retrieval in clipboardUtils.ts. Per the effort guidelines, platform-specific bugs requiring cross-environment setup (Linux clipboard/WSL2) must be rated as MEDIUM rather than SMALL.

summary.problem: Image pasting via Alt+V fails in WSL2 environments when XDG_SESSION_TYPE is unset and the clipboard exposes image/bmp.
summary.root_cause: getUserLinuxClipboardTool in clipboardUtils.ts relies exclusively on process.env['XDG_SESSION_TYPE'] to select between wl-paste and xclip, failing when XDG_SESSION_TYPE is missing. Additionally, saveFileWithWlPaste and saveFileWithXclip hardcode request for image/png MIME type, failing when the clipboard only offers image/bmp.
summary.context: In WSL2 Ubuntu on Windows hosts, XDG_SESSION_TYPE is commonly unset while WAYLAND_DISPLAY or DISPLAY is set. When copying images on Windows, the Linux clipboard bridge presents image data as image/bmp rather than image/png.

steps: In packages/cli/src/ui/utils/clipboardUtils.ts, update getUserLinuxClipboardTool to check process.env['WAYLAND_DISPLAY'] and process.env['DISPLAY'] as fallback environment variables when process.env['XDG_SESSION_TYPE'] is unset.
Update saveFileWithWlPaste and saveFileWithXclip in packages/cli/src/ui/utils/clipboardUtils.ts to support image/bmp alongside image/png when querying/saving clipboard content.
Add .bmp to IMAGE_EXTENSIONS in packages/cli/src/ui/utils/clipboardUtils.ts so that saved BMP clipboard images are properly recognized and cleaned up.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Clipboard image detection and saving succeeds in WSL2 environments where XDG_SESSION_TYPE is unset but WAYLAND_DISPLAY or DISPLAY is present, and correctly handles image/bmp clipboard formats.
verification_steps: Add test cases in clipboardUtils.test.ts verifying getUserLinuxClipboardTool detects wl-paste when XDG_SESSION_TYPE is unset but WAYLAND_DISPLAY is set.
Add test cases in clipboardUtils.test.ts verifying getUserLinuxClipboardTool detects xclip when XDG_SESSION_TYPE is unset but DISPLAY is set.
Add test cases in clipboardUtils.test.ts verifying saveClipboardImage succeeds when clipboard content is provided as image/bmp.
